## Work History Summary

### Wonderful.ai

Alejandro Sanabria is a Forward Deployed Engineer at Wonderful.ai. His work sits close to customers, product context, AI systems, implementation details, and delivery. The role combines engineering judgment, applied AI, and product execution.

### Baubap

Alejandro Sanabria spent three months as an engineering manager building Baubap's first iOS app. He managed a team across several product and technical domains and worked on an AI bot for customer success. This work connects mobile delivery, domain coordination, customer success, and applied AI.

### Platzi

Alejandro Sanabria joined Platzi as one of its first mobile engineers and later helped lead mobile engineering across iOS and Android. His work included React Native, native iOS with Swift and SwiftUI, native Android with Kotlin, platform architecture, shared mobile standards, technical debt reduction, mentoring, and delivery execution.

## Projects

### Cifro

Cifro is a published private-by-design iOS finance app built by Alejandro Sanabria. It uses SwiftUI and Apple Foundation Models for on-device AI features such as transaction parsing, budget bucket suggestions, daily insights, and review rituals.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/co/app/cifro-budget-finance/id6759523370?l=en-GB

### iOS Workflow Systems

Alejandro Sanabria builds reusable AI-assisted workflows for iOS architecture, implementation planning, code review, validation, App Store operations, and screenshot generation. These workflows encode practical engineering judgment into repeatable systems.

Repository: https://github.com/alesanabriav7/ios-architect-skill

### App Store and Screenshot Automation

Alejandro Sanabria builds TypeScript command-line tooling for App Store Connect metadata, build upload automation, deterministic iOS simulator screenshots, App Store assets, visual checks, and CI workflows.

Repositories:

- https://github.com/alesanabriav7/appstore-tools
- https://github.com/alesanabriav7/screenshots-ios
